title: Error log entry dated today (2026-06-09)
detail: merge_worktree.sh main..worktree diff logic bug (strike-2). Script incorrectly used git diff main..worktree for shared-path detection instead of git diff $(merge-base)..worktree, causing false-positive abort on K1426 and K1427 worktrees. Workaround: manual git merge --no-ff -X theirs. Strike 3 will trigger full refactor per three-strike rule.
